pictocat-desc: Provides the description of the extension for Special:Version.
prefs-pictocat: Heading for PictoCat's section in user preferences.
pictocat-preference-use-label: Label for the user preference of whether to show image previews in categories.
pictocat-preference-use-default: User preference option to follow the default behavior of each category.
pictocat-preference-use-bullet: User preference option to always use the 'bullet' style.
pictocat-preference-use-gallery: User preference option to always use the 'gallery' style.
visualeditor-dialog-meta-settings-use-pi: Label for checkbox to add __PICTOCAT__ magic word.
visualeditor-dialog-meta-settings-no-pic: Label for checkbox to add __NOPICTOCAT__ magic word.
visualeditor-dialog-meta-settings-use-bu: Label for checkbox to add __USEBULLETSTYLE__ magic word.
visualeditor-dialog-meta-settings-use-ga: Label for checkbox to add __USEGALLERYSTYLE__ magic word.
